# Lifetime Smiles Cosmetic Dentistry

> > A comprehensive South Austin dental practice offering cosmetic, general, family, and implant dentistry with advanced technology and expert care.

Lifetime Smiles Cosmetic Dentistry is led by Dr. Arzegar and serves the South Austin community with a full range of dental services from preventive care to advanced restorative and cosmetic procedures. The practice emphasizes state-of-the-art technology, including 3D digital imaging, and provides emergency dental care.
